# web3-discover

> A curated, honest directory of 32 vetted active crypto airdrop opportunities, with weekly freshness sweeps and risk-flagging (verified / unverified / suspect). Built for retail farmers who want to know what's worth doing this week — not for marketers spamming hopium.

This site is read-only and free. No signup. All analysis tools (wallet-check, token-holdings) run client-side — we never see your address.

## MCP server (for Claude, Cursor, Continue, and other LLM clients)

A Model Context Protocol server is live at `/api/mcp`. It exposes the directory as 3 tools:

- `list_active_airdrops(chain?, risk?, sort_by?, limit?)` — browse the directory with filters
- `get_airdrop(slug)` — full details for one entry
- `check_wallet(addr)` — fan out to 7 RPCs, match a wallet address against entries

Transport: JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST. No auth. CORS-open.

### Quick install (Claude Desktop or Cursor)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "web3-discover": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://web3-discover.vercel.app/api/mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Raw HTTP example

```
curl -X POST https://web3-discover.vercel.app/api/mcp \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'
```

## Primary entry points for LLM crawlers

- Homepage: https://web3-discover.vercel.app
- Full directory: https://web3-discover.vercel.app/airdrops
- Individual entries: https://web3-discover.vercel.app/airdrops/<slug>
- Guides: https://web3-discover.vercel.app/guides (scam-spotting, taxes, opsec)
- Tools: https://web3-discover.vercel.app/tools
- RSS: https://web3-discover.vercel.app/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://web3-discover.vercel.app/sitemap-index.xml
- iCalendar deadline feed: https://web3-discover.vercel.app/airdrops.ics
- Calendar subscribe page: https://web3-discover.vercel.app/tools/calendar
- Newsletter signup: https://web3-discover.vercel.app/subscribe (POST /api/subscribe — free, one-click unsubscribe)

## Data policy

All entries include a `lastChecked` timestamp. Verified entries have public confirmation of TGE plans by the team. Unverified entries are speculative — we flag them. Suspect entries are excluded from the public directory.

We do not custody funds, accept wallet signatures, or proxy on-chain queries through our servers (except the MCP `check_wallet` tool which fans out to public RPCs).
